annotations.text:
Pattern: Whitney Bartlette numbered-list carousel. Count in the cover, the list IS the deliverable, no keyword gate.
Sorted by how little the format asks of you, so the lowest-effort options sit first where the objection lives.
Every hook is for a format where you never appear on camera: listing photos, a screen recording, text on black, green screen.

All six slides sit inside the 4:5 safe band (y 152..1184), so the set lines up on swipe and any slide survives the 1:1 profile-grid crop.
Verify with: node ~/.claude/skills/skool-carousel/references/check-slides.mjs
